nodes.name: Self-Care Chatbot Agent

nodes.name: Bill Explainer Agent
nodes.notes: Answers "why is my bill high?" with plain-language invoice breakdowns for CSR and self-care channels.

nodes.name: Partner Onboarding Agent
nodes.notes: Guides new dealer/partner through portal registration, KYC, and channel hierarchy assignment.

nodes.name: POS Retail Assist Agent

nodes.name: Agent-Assist in Care

nodes.name: Dealer Onboarding Agent

nodes.name: CSR AI Assistant Agent
nodes.notes: Real-time agentic assist surfacing answers and next-best-action prompts for care agents during live interactions.

nodes.name: Coalition Partner Agent

nodes.name: Commission Calculation Agent

nodes.notes: Real-time anomaly detection on CDRs — SIM swap, grey routes, interconnect fraud, and subscription abuse.

nodes.notes: Continuously validates API conformance to TMF 620/622/641/666 across all integration touchpoints.

nodes.name: Multi-OpCo Tenant Agent
nodes.notes: Monitors tenant boundary integrity and data residency compliance across all OpCo deployments.

nodes.name: GDPR & Data Residency Agent

nodes.name: RPO/RTO Simulation Agent
nodes.notes: Runs DR scenario simulations on Kubernetes clusters to validate RPO/RTO targets before go-live cutover.

nodes.name: IAM & Certificate Rotation Agent
nodes.notes: Manages OAuth/OIDC/mTLS certificate lifecycle, rotation schedules, and IAM policy audit logging.

nodes.name: Infra Drift Detection Agent

nodes.name: Order Fallout & Jeopardy Agent

nodes.name: Revenue Leakage Detection Agent

nodes.name: Collections & Dunning Agent

nodes.name: Promotion Eligibility Agent

nodes.name: Tariff Change Impact Agent

nodes.name: Field Workforce Agent

nodes.name: Closed-Loop Assurance Agent

nodes.name: Jeopardy & SLA Agent

nodes.name: Activation Workflow Agent

nodes.notes: Automates dry-run data quality checks, mapping validation, and post-migration reconciliation across OpCo cutovers.

nodes.notes: Tracks multi-OpCo rollout milestones, flags dependency conflicts, and surfaces delivery risk with mitigations.
